summary.en: A melonJS-powered Flappy Bird clone that faithfully recreates the original's feel and look.
summary.zh: 《Flappy Bird》的 melonJS 引擎复刻版，手感与画风高度还原。

description.en: Tap or press space to flap upward, release and let gravity pull you back down, threading the gaps between pipes. Clip a pipe or hit the ground and it's over — one point per pipe cleared.
description.zh: 点击/空格让小鸟拍翅上升，松手下落，穿过水管之间的空隙，撞管或落地即结束，过一根得一分。

tip.en: The quintessential rage game — players love bragging about their scores, so sharing rates run high. Built on melonJS, it re-skins easily: swap the bird and pipe sprites and you have a fresh title.
tip.zh: 虐心类代表，分享率高（晒分数）。基于 melonJS，换皮容易：替换小鸟与水管贴图就是一款新游戏。
